title: External Hose Replacement Kit for Basic Brake Fluid Exchanger Machines
lead: A new kit of replacement hoses is now available for the external hoses used on the Basic Brake Fluid Exchanger Machines (Part No. 98060). This kit includes a vacuum, pressure and service hose cut to length, along with the clamps needed to attach the hoses to existing hardware and connect them to the machines.
